name: Qualcomm

Software Engineer.dsaDepth: Moderate - an OA mixing C/C++/OS multiple-choice with 2-3 easy–medium coding problems, then a loop weighted toward core fundamentals over pure algorithms
rounds: Online assessment (HackerRank, ~90 min): MCQs on C, C++, OS and computer architecture, plus 2-3 coding problems (easy–medium, pointer and bit-manipulation questions are common)
Technical screen (~30-45 min, often with the hiring manager): resume/project questions, C/memory/OS basics
Interview loop (3-4 rounds, 45-60 min each): coding (arrays, linked lists, trees; DP/heap/hashing also reported), OS/driver-level questions, design, and a behavioral/HR round
extraTopics: Bit manipulation and pointer-heavy C problems, tested more here than at most software-only companies
OS internals and, for driver-adjacent teams, hardware/driver-specific questions
Software Engineer.notes: India-specific reports (Hyderabad, Bhopal) show anywhere from 2 to 5 rounds and describe the process as notably slow (one report: 6 months end-to-end).

sources.title: What Is the Qualcomm Interview Process Like? (DesignGurus)
used: full stage breakdown: recruiter screen, HackerRank OA (C/C++/OS MCQs + coding), technical screen, 3-4 round loop

sources.title: Glassdoor: Qualcomm Software Engineer interview reports, Hyderabad
used: 3-round loop (2 technical + HR), standard DSA from LeetCode

sources.title: Glassdoor: Qualcomm Associate Engineer interview report, Hyderabad
used: OA then 4 back-to-back technical rounds covering coding and driver-level core questions

sources.title: Glassdoor: Qualcomm Senior Software Engineer interview report, Cork/Hyderabad
used: 5-step loop: 4 technical + 1 HR, DSA plus puzzles plus experience discussion

rolesNotes: OA and loop structure are corroborated across several independent reports, including India-specific ones. Senior/Staff-level detail beyond the loop shape is thin.
indiaNote: Multiple reports come from Qualcomm’s Hyderabad and Bengaluru offices; the India process is reported as notably slower than average (weeks to several months).
